tasks.title: Conversation #50
tasks.transcript:
Man: Hi, Susan. Did you get the email from our professor about the system upgrade?
Woman: Yes I did. It says the upgrade will happen overnight on Saturday.
Man: Right? They mentioned that we might experience some downtime on Sunday morning.
Woman: Okay, well, most people won't be working in the lab then. Do we need to back up our files?
Man: Yes, IT recommended backing up everything before the weekend.
Woman: Good to know. I'll make sure to do that.

questions.stem: When will the system upgrade take place?
questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：系统升级将在何时进行？属于细节理解题。 定位原文：Woman: It says the upgrade will happen overnight on Saturday. Man: Right? They mentioned that we might experience some downtime on Sunday morning. 选项分析： A. Over the weekend 周末。因为女士提到升级在周六晚上，男士补充说周日早上可能会停机，这说明升级过程跨越了整个周末，所以 A 选项正确。 B. During lunch 午餐期间。因为对话中提到的是周六晚上和周日早上，并非午餐时间，所以 B 选项错误。 C. On Friday 在周五。因为对话明确说是周六晚上开始，所以 C 选项错误。 D. The next morning 第二天早上。因为对话提到的是周六晚上开始，周日早上是可能受影响的时间，而不是升级发生的时间，所以 D 选项错误。

questions.stem: What did IT recommend the employees do?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：IT 部门建议员工做什么？属于细节理解题。 定位原文：Man: Yes, IT recommended backing up everything before the weekend. 选项分析： A. Update their passwords 更新密码。因为对话中未提及密码相关的内容，所以 A 选项错误。 B. Back up their files 备份文件。由于男士明确提到 IT 部门建议在周末前备份所有文件，所以 B 选项正确。 C. Install a software upgrade 安装软件升级。因为系统升级是由 IT 部门进行的，不是建议员工自己安装，所以 C 选项错误。 D. Contact the help desk 联系帮助台。因为对话中未提及需要联系帮助台，只是传达了 IT的建议，所以 D 选项错误。
